newsitem.title: MEXICO: ASA to invest 20 mln pesos in Monterrey airport.
newsitem.headline: ASA to invest 20 mln pesos in Monterrey airport.

text.p: The Mexican government's Airports and Auxiliary Services (ASA) office said on Thursday it will invest 20 million pesos in the Monterrey airport before the end of the year in preparation for privatisation.
"For this year, ASA will invest a little more than 20 million pesos in the Mariano Escobedo Airport," Alfredo Elias Ayub told reporters, according to a Nuevo Leon state government news release.
He said the money was destined to improve airport operations but did not give further details.
The airport, which is actually in the city of Apodaca, about 30 miles (45 km) northeast of Monterrey, will be among the first to be privatised by the federal government, Elias said.
Final rules and dates for privatisation have not been set, but foreign ownership of airports will be limited to 49 percent, Elias said.
